name: Section

representativeVariants.body: a card group without a header

structurePatterns: vertical group with a header row (title + optional supporting text + trailing action) and content below
no background or border by default; sections group content before Cards are considered
title uses heading-small; supporting text uses body-small secondary; trailing action is a brand text button
usageHints: prefer Section grouping before wrapping content in a Card
section does not require a background or border
trailing action is for navigation to 'see all' / 'manage', not primary actions
doNotInvent: no bold large title (that is a page heading)
